title: Formatter-off biome override for byte-frozen check-all scripts
rationale: biome at lineWidth 100 wants to reformat the fleet-frozen scripts (check-all.ts:144 join, check-ci-parity.ts:108 signature); editing them would break cmp byte-identity with templates/l5-toolkit, so the exemption must live repo-side in biome.json.

content: Budgets live next to their ratchet scripts: scripts/file-size-budgets.json (threshold 500, 12 grandfathered files), scripts/coverage-budgets.json (floors: functions 83, lines 85 vs measured 83.29/85.69), scripts/debt-markers-budget.json (tracker prefixes sapling-/pl-/mx- hex ids, #NNN, URLs; empty allowlist). The ratchet scripts' DEFAULT_*_PATH constants were adapted from the toolkit's budgets/ dir to resolve(SCRIPT_DIR, ...). Ratchets: size/debt only tighten, coverage only rises; loosening needs an explicit human commit.
